xBRIEFInfo.description: Land ADR-004 and salvage architecture-independent pieces from halted PR 3453. Does not implement the side-effect port or close #3437 / PR 3453.

narratives.Description: Keep the parent-authored ADR-004. Record it in the structured decision log. Salvage only architecture-independent pieces from halted PR 3453: route removeStaleMigratedFrameworkNarrative through containedRemove, land a narrowed static import-ban on that function, and plant the obsolete migrated narrative in the existing dry-run byte-identical fixture. Do not implement collect-only, planRefreshDeposit, planned_paths, strategy, or collectReplaceTreeMutations. Do not close #3437 or merge/close PR 3453.
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer landing the accepted dry-run architecture, I want ADR-004 and the independent 3453 salvage on master so the replacement story can start from a recorded decision and a correct dest-delete chokepoint.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1) Record decision JSON via task decision:write --body-file. 2) Route removeStaleMigratedFrameworkNarrative through containedRemove. 3) Land a contract test that bans raw dest-mutating node:fs only on that function. 4) Plant the obsolete migrated narrative in the #3456 dry-run hash test. 5) CHANGELOG [Unreleased] process/docs line citing #3462 / ADR-004.
narratives.Origin: Operator acceptance of #3462 Current shape (pass-2) plus salvage-then-close-3453 instruction. Prior art SHA 2f6e4ce11b73f158f9f5e1ddf738ad98c558161b.
narratives.Decisions: - xbrief/decisions/2026-08-18-update-dry-run-plan.decision.json — deft update --dry-run plan is construction-level collection via one injected write/remove/exec port. PR 3453 is replace after architecture-independent salvage. #3437 stays open until the replacement that implements ADR-004 merges.

items.title: Land ADR-004 and structured decision record

narrative.Acceptance: docs/decisions/ADR-004-update-dry-run-plan.md remains the parent-authored text (three conditions unweakened). xbrief/decisions/2026-08-18-update-dry-run-plan.decision.json exists from task decision:write. CHANGELOG [Unreleased] has a process/docs line citing #3462 / ADR-004.

packages/core/src/xbrief-migrate/migrate-project.ts removeStaleMigratedFrameworkNarrative deletes via containedRemove and does not call rmSync. Existing migrate-project.test.ts stale-narrative test still passes.

items.title: Narrow static dest-mutation ban on that function

narrative.Acceptance: A contract test fails if removeStaleMigratedFrameworkNarrative uses raw dest-mutating node:fs (rmSync, writeFileSync, renameSync, copyFileSync, …). It does not walk all of init-deposit/** and does not require collectReplaceTreeMutations.

items.title: Plant obsolete narrative in dry-run hash fixture

narrative.Acceptance: The existing test full dry-run leaves the fixture tree byte-identical (#3456) plants the obsolete migrated narrative. After dry-run the planted file still exists and the tree hash is unchanged.

references.title: Issue #3462: ADR for update dry-run plan architecture
